message.content:
Based on my search, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series was created by writer Robert Kirkman and artist Tony Moore, with the first issue published on **October 8, 2003** by Image Comics. The AMC television series adaptation didn't premiere until **October 31, 2010** — a full seven years later. AMC had picked up the rights to produce the show in August 2009, ordered six episodes for the first season in March 2010, and began filming the pilot in May 2010.
